create_multiindex_from_arrays: create a MultiIndex from arrays where each array represents one level of the hierarchical index
create_multiindex_from_tuples: create a MultiIndex from a list of tuples where each tuple represents a multi-level key
create_multiindex_from_product: create a MultiIndex from the cartesian product of multiple iterables
create_multiindex_from_frame: create a MultiIndex from a DataFrame where each column becomes one level
build_multiindex_set_levels: build a new MultiIndex with updated level values using set_levels method
build_multiindex_swaplevel: build a new MultiIndex with two levels swapped by position or name
build_multiindex_sortlevel: build a sorted MultiIndex at the requested level with optional descending order
test_multiindex_get_loc: test the get_loc method to find integer location, slice, or boolean mask for a key
test_multiindex_get_level_values: test the get_level_values method to extract values from a specific level
test_multiindex_duplicated: test the duplicated method to identify duplicate index values across all levels
test_multiindex_dropped: test the drop method to remove specified labels from a MultiIndex by level
refactor_multiindex_remove_unused: refactor a MultiIndex to remove unused level values that are no longer represented in the data
refactor_multiindex_reorder_levels: refactor a MultiIndex to rearrange levels in a specified order by position or name
summarize_multiindex_to_frame: summarize a MultiIndex as a DataFrame with each level as a column
summarize_multiindex_dtypes: summarize the dtypes of all levels in a MultiIndex as a Series
run_multiindex_isin: run the isin method to check which MultiIndex entries match a set of values
run_multiindex_take: run the take method to select MultiIndex elements at specified integer indices
run_multiindex_append: run the append method to concatenate multiple MultiIndex objects together
run_multiindex_truncate: run the truncate method to slice a MultiIndex between two label boundaries on the first level
